input: Pick up prescription refill before Friday

gold.taskTitle: Pick Up Prescription Refill Before Friday
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to collect a prescription refill from a pharmacy before Friday.

questions.title: Which pharmacy holds your prescription refill?
questions.description: Identify the specific pharmacy where the refill needs to be picked up.

questions.title: Has the refill already been requested or approved?
questions.description: Determine whether the refill request has been submitted to the pharmacy or doctor.

questions.title: What is the exact prescription medication being refilled?
questions.description: Identify the specific medication so it can be tracked and confirmed.

questions.title: What are the pharmacy's operating hours this week?
questions.description: Confirm when the pharmacy is open to plan a feasible pickup window.

questions.title: Do you need a doctor's authorization before pickup?
questions.description: Determine if a prescription renewal or doctor approval is still required.

questions.title: Is there a specific day before Friday you prefer?
questions.description: Narrow down the ideal or required pickup day within the available window.

questions.title: Will you pick it up yourself or need someone else?
questions.description: Clarify who is responsible for the physical pickup and if any authorization is needed.
